Name: Metalworking
Author: P1edy
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Finding it boring to just sell (or hoard) excess metal ore and bars? Now you can use them to make profitable artisan items to increase your cashflow! Metalworking uses copper, iron, gold, iridium, and radioactive bars to make over 70 artisan pieces of art.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install Extra Machine configs if you have not already and then download this mod and put it in your mods directory.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
 - Added Artisan Anvil machine
 - Make metal art items with all five base game metals
 - Copper and iron have 12 art pieces each
 - Gold, iridium, and radioactive have 16 art pieces each
 - Spanish translation included (as I am not a native speaker, please let me know if any edits should be made)

[size=4][b]Spoilers:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]The day after reaching level 5 in the mines, Clint will send a letter with an artisan anvil
Upon reaching mining level 3, the artisan anvil recipe will be obtained
Completed artisan art pieces all require two-three items.

Claws require a clay and a metal bar
Crowns require a topaz/jade/amethyst/diamond/emerald and a metal bar
Rings require a geode/frozen geode/magma geode and a copper/iron/radioactive bar
Necklaces require a aquamarine/ruby and a gold/iridium bar
Cluster arts require an ore and the same metal bar
Art pieces require a coal and a metal bar
Lanterns require a sap, a glass shards and a metal bar (not copper)
Candle requires a sap and a copper bar
Medals require a cloth and a metal bar
Eggs require an egg and a metal bar (gold, iridium, radioactive) and differ by season
Armor pieces (helmet week 1, breastplate week 2, greaves week 3, gauntlets week 4) require a bat wing and two identical metal bars
Weapons require a wood and two identical metal bars[/spoiler]
